name: agent-elements
description: Use whenever the user wants to build or modify a chat, agent, or tool-calling UI in a React 19 + Tailwind v4 project — especially if the code imports from `@/components/agent-elements/*` or the project has that folder on disk. Triggers: "agent chat", "tool call UI", "streaming chat", "plan approval", "AgentChat", "InputBar", "tool renderer", mentions of Agent Elements, or requests to add a new agent surface with shadcn. Do NOT use for plain chat UIs that don't need tool/plan/approval cards, or for projects already committed to a different agent UI kit.
author: 21st-dev
